parent_objective: audit controlled routing-smoke measured execution result before any ranking or repair
blocked_by: M2039 measured execution pass requires audit before interpretation
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from raw measured execution

public_gates: M2040 must audit M2039 execution completeness metadata metrics and guardrails
M2040 must quantify raw outcomes and offtrack/collision dominance before any comparison
M2040 must decide ranking-ready versus outcome localization or task-quality repair
M2040 must keep paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank controller families without first deciding comparison readiness
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether measured execution data is comparison-ready or needs localization/repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no new rollout ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2039 execution is incomplete
stop if metric or metadata gates failed
stop if outcomes are too low-support for ranking
stop if claim boundary admits paper or self-ID claims
fallback_plan: route to outcome localization if execution is complete but low-support
route to runner repair if execution artifacts are incomplete
route to ranking design only if outcome support is adequate
route to branch synthesis if measured execution exposes a broader route decision
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2039 writes measured execution artifacts and names M2040 as next blocker

training_stage.stage_objective: controlled routing-smoke measured execution result audit
admission_evidence: M2039 measured execution completed 432 episodes with failure 0 and guardrail 0
blocked_shortcuts: do not run new rollout during audit
do not rank before comparison readiness is decided
do not interpret smoke execution as paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2040 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for outcome localization, ranking design, task-quality repair, or synthesis

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2040 audits measured rollout only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2040.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If outcomes are low-support or offtrack-dominated, route to localization/repair instead of ranking.
allowed_claims: controlled routing-smoke measured execution result audit
no paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits first complete controlled routing-smoke measured execution
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether this controlled panel supports comparison or needs repair/localization
must_synthesize_if: M2040 finds complete execution but low-support outcomes
M2040 cannot choose between localization and repair
M2040 would require another narrow runner/adapter milestone

hypothesis: M2039 measured execution artifacts are complete enough to audit comparison readiness and choose the next route without making ranking or paper claims.
failure_criteria: audit makes ranking or paper claims prematurely

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit runs/m2039_paper_route_controlled_routing_smoke_measured_execution artifacts and write M2040 result audit

decision_rule: M2040 passes if it audits M2039 completeness and chooses ranking design, localization, repair, or synthesis without overclaiming.
